sentences.text: Section 8.2 does not comply with the applicable RBI rule because the policy says penal interest at 2% per month over the applicable rate of interest shall be charged on overdue instalments and compounded monthly, while the governing rule finding says penal interest is not permitted.
The applicable RBI findings also require penal charges to follow the stated conditions, rather than being levied as penal interest.
The evidence searched for the policy does not show any wording in section 8.2 that converts this charge into penal charges or otherwise brings it within the stated conditions.
The evidence searched does not include any sanction date or other case fact that would change this conclusion.

missing.searched: Checked the provided case facts and rule findings; no sanction date was supplied.
